source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey,

Your clips are approved and ready to go live. Here is exactly how to post each one:

**POSTING INSTRUCTIONS**

1\. Upload the clip as a Reel on your assigned Instagram account
2\. Use this caption for every clip:

*Follow @tonalexina for more 🔥*

3\. Add these hashtags to every post:
#teyronalexina #personaldevelopment #entrepreneurship #mindset #motivation #selfimprovement #businessadvice #successmindset #growthmindset #ecommerce

4\. Tag @tonalexina in the post itself — not just the caption
5\. Post at peak hours — between 6pm and 9pm for best reach
6\. Once posted — update the card in Notion with the Date Posted and the Instagram link to the reel

Post all 3 clips — space them out, one per day for maximum reach. Do not post all three on the same day.

Any questions — message me immediately.

Cleavon

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Just wanted to clarify a couple of things before I start posting:

Could you please let me know which 3 clips were approved? If possible, please send me their names.
Could you also send me the Notion link (or the specific page) where I need to update the Date Posted and the Instagram Reel link after each post?

Thanks!

ambiguity.description: The required Notion card or page was not identified, leaving the destination for posting-date and Reel-link updates unresolved.

routing_warnings.description: The instruction to report back after posting concerns client-facing publication reporting rather than updating the Notion tracking card.
The request to send the published link belongs to the separate Reel-link reporting Requirement.
The freelancer sends the published Reel link to the client, but this does not establish that the Notion card was updated.
